measured.source: measured 2026-09-10 by pgrepair (SciPyWeightedILP) on the frozen EUR-Lex truth, three identical runs, journal sha256 in measures/reachability-by-damage-2026-09-10.json. Per damage class, not per form: two forms of the same damage and the same visibility get the same answer.

obstacle.reason: Reached in full, and at a cost: the repair deletes the nodes rather than their labels. The information that would put the label right is in the node itself — the identifier says the type — and one statement of the graph's own query language sets it back with nothing destroyed.
obstacle.reason_fr: Atteinte en entier, et à un prix : la réparation supprime les nœuds plutôt que leurs étiquettes. L'information qui remettrait l'étiquette droite est dans le nœud lui-même — l'identifiant dit le type — et une instruction du langage de requête du graphe la repose sans rien détruire.
obstacle.source: derived from what a deletion-only repair can express, read in the repairer's own code — its solution is a set of elements to delete and carries no insertion — together with the measurement of 2026-09-10. Per damage class, not per form.
